summary: Describes an experimental use of STUN that lets a client find out how the NATs and firewalls between it and a STUN server behave. This helps applications understand the kind of address translation and filtering they face. It was published as an experiment, not as a standard.

eli5.summary: You toss a few test balls through a gate to a friend and see which ones get through and which get blocked, to learn how the gate works.

questions: how to discover nat behavior with stun
what is stun nat behavior discovery
